event_contract.fit_path: For each origin t and H, OLS log(close[t+j]) = intercept + beta*j + epsilon for j=0..H; slope t-statistic is a standardized path-shape score only, not an IID significance test.
event_contract.past_scale: sigma60 = ddof=1 standard deviation of daily log returns over preceding 60 sessions, minimum 30, using no future return.
event_contract.scale_selection: H_star = argmax absolute slope_t_stat across frozen H; ties choose shorter H.
event_contract.precedence: DOWN before SIDEWAYS at same origin; otherwise OTHER
event_contract.onset_extraction: For each asset,event_type,duration_grade, contiguous candidate run onset is first date. Same-type new onsets suppressed ceil(H_star/2) sessions. A strictly longer duration grade may begin a hierarchical new episode only after 10 sessions.
event_contract.risk_set: Dates in an already-started event suppression interval are excluded from classifier risk set and are not negatives.

warning_targets.T1_ANY_DOWN: D1_SHORT or D2_MEDIUM or D3_LONG or D4_SECULAR
warning_targets.binary_label: For an at-risk date t and lead L, Y_L[t]=1 iff a qualifying unique onset occurs in strictly future (t,t+L]; else 0.

time_contract.fit_label_maturity_rule: origin + L + 240 sessions strictly earlier than refit date
time_contract.decision_timing: Prediction after completed close t may affect only portfolio return row t+1.

feature_contract.missing_value_rule: Training-column median at each refit; all-missing required training column causes config/track MODEL_FIT_FAILURE.

indicator_atlas.orientation: TRAIN-only sign of point-biserial association; zero tie +1; no validation/final sign flip.
indicator_atlas.P03_screening: VALIDATION only: positive PR-AUC lift, >=3/4 positive blocks, max 2 signals/family, max 12 signals; ties frozen signal ID; no FINAL screening.
indicator_atlas.final_multiplicity: One-sided Mann-Whitney U equivalent to TRAIN-oriented ROC-AUC>0.50, Holm-Bonferroni FWER 0.05 across all supported FINAL cells.

P08_STACKED_PROBABILITY_ENSEMBLE.fit: scipy.optimize.nnls; normalize nonnegative weights; equal 1/7 fallback if zero/nonfinite

validation_selection.preferred_warning_horizon: highest VALIDATION PR_AUC_LIFT; tie LONGER horizon
validation_selection.preferred_architecture: highest VALIDATION PR_AUC_LIFT; tie ROC_AUC, lower Brier, architecture ID
validation_selection.controller_exact_horizon_resolution: 5D/10D controllers use exact lead and validation-best architecture at that lead; C06 exact 3D/5D/10D; C07 exact required down/sideways components.

predictive_final_gates.G4: preferred lead>=5 OR adjacent pair {3,5}/{5,10}/{10,20} both G2
predictive_final_gates.G5: simultaneous one-sided 95% dependence-aware bootstrap LCB FINAL PR_AUC_LIFT >0

controller_contract.threshold_calibration: empirical risk percentiles fit on causal VALIDATION predictions only
controller_contract.C07: DOWN precedence; SIDEWAYS only if no stronger DOWN

economic_gates.E1: terminal wealth and CAGR strictly exceed same-window 0064
economic_gates.E3: >=3/4 economic blocks positive relative log growth
economic_gates.E4: simultaneous one-sided 95% MBB LCB mean relative daily log increment >0

simultaneous_inference.predictive: one max-stat correction across confirmatory predictor tracks; no retrain/reorient/rescreen/recalibrate
simultaneous_inference.economic: same sampled indices for all valid controllers; max-stat simultaneous LCB

temporal_blocks.construction: count-balanced contiguous eligible rows; earlier blocks receive remainder

selection_risk.selection_statistic: controller annualized Sharpe on in-sample slices

exactly_once.marker_only_recovery: only if complete PRIMARY_RESULT+EVIDENCE+EXECUTION already durably persist and only RUN_ONCE.marker is missing
